lang.description: The warning page's <html lang>: the language of the catalog actually shown.

actionTitle.description: Toolbar icon tooltip. Problems, if any, follow on their own lines.

problemRuleNotRegistered.message: Blocking is off: the blocking rule could not be registered.
problemRuleNotRegistered.description: Tooltip line shown with the ! badge when updateDynamicRules failed.

problemNoSiteAccess.message: Blocking is off: set site access to "On all sites".
problemNoSiteAccess.description: Tooltip line shown with the ! badge when the extension cannot access all sites.

noticeUserinfoOff.message: Blocking URLs with user info: off
noticeUserinfoOff.description: Tooltip line while the user has turned off blocking URLs with user info. No badge.

noticeIpHostsOff.description: Tooltip line while the user has turned off blocking IP address hosts. No badge.

noticePrivateIpsExcluded.message: Blocking IP address hosts: private IP addresses excluded
noticePrivateIpsExcluded.description: Tooltip line while private IP addresses are excluded from blocking IP address hosts. No badge.

extensionDescription.message: Blocks navigation to URLs that disguise where they lead (internationalized domain names, URLs with user info and IP address hosts) and shows a warning page instead.
extensionDescription.description: Extension description in the Chrome Web Store and chrome://extensions.

heading.description: Main heading of the warning page.

explanation.message: This page's address has a form used to disguise where it really leads.
explanation.description: Why the page was blocked. A section for each reason follows when the URL can be read.

unreadableUrl.message: The address of the blocked page could not be read.
unreadableUrl.description: Shown instead of the details when the fragment does not hold an http(s) URL.

headingIdnHost.description: Heading of the IDN host reason on the warning page.

explanationIdnHost.message: The host uses an internationalized domain name (IDN). Letters from other scripts can make such an address look like a familiar site, so PunyGuard blocks every IDN host.

headingUserinfo.description: Heading of the userinfo reason on the warning page.

explanationUserinfo.message: The part of the address before "@" is a user name, not the destination. Putting a familiar domain before "@" makes a link look as if it leads to that site.
explanationUserinfo.description: Why URLs with user info are blocked.

labelUserinfo.description: Label for the user info in the URL (user name, and any password masked as ***), shown as plain text.

labelActualHost.description: Label for the host the URL really leads to.

headingIpHost.description: Heading of the IP address host reason on the warning page.

explanationIpHost.message: The address uses an IP address instead of a host name. An IP address does not tell you which site it is.
explanationIpHost.description: Why IP address hosts are blocked.

labelIpAddress.description: Label for the IP address host.

labelOriginalUrl.description: Label for the blocked URL, shown as plain text.

labelUnicode.description: Label for the host as the user would see it.

labelPunycode.description: Label for the xn-- form of the host.

goBack.description: Secondary button, shown when the tab has history.

scriptOther.description: Script name for anything not listed.

optionsTitle.description: Title and heading of the options page.

optionsIntro.message: Internationalized domain names (IDN) are always blocked. You can turn off the blocking below. Changes are saved at once and apply from the next navigation.

optionExcludePrivateIps.message: Except private IP addresses (devices on your local network, localhost and the like)
optionExcludePrivateIps.description: Checkbox under the IP address host one; disabled while that is off.

optionsSaveFailed.message: The settings could not be saved. The page shows the saved settings again.
optionsSaveFailed.description: Shown when saving the settings fails.
